Getting ripped comes down to two things: lifting enough to keep your muscle, and eating to lose fat. The split is the easier part. A 4-day upper/lower or a 5-day push/pull/legs both work well. The better one is whichever you'll hit every week for six months.

I'll build it around what you tell me. How many days a week can you train, how long per session, and are you at a full gym? Also let me know if you hate any exercises. Give me those and I'll set up the program for you to confirm.
